//: Log messages Vintage Doctor explains by itself. Other mods add their own with a file of the same name and shape in assets/<their mod id>/config/ (see docs/api.md).

knownProblems.title: A model has two attachment points with the same name
knownProblems.explain: Whatever gets attached there (clothes, a tool in a hand, a rider) may sit in the wrong place. Nothing else is affected.
knownProblems.advice: The model's author can fix it by giving each point its own name.

knownProblems.match: Found closing tag char > but no tag was opened
knownProblems.title: A text has a stray '>' in it
knownProblems.explain: The game reads '<' and '>' as formatting marks. That one text may show oddly; nothing else is affected.

knownProblems.match: Index (zero based) must be greater than or equal to zero and less than the size of the argument list
knownProblems.title: A translated text asks for more values than the game gives it
knownProblems.explain: Only that text shows wrong (usually as its raw key). The mod's author or its translator can fix it.

knownProblems.match: uses blocks that could no longer be found
knownProblems.title: A structure that generates in the world uses blocks that don't exist
knownProblems.explain: Those parts of the structure will be air. The structure was made for another version of the game or expects another mod.

knownProblems.match: uses items that could no longer be found
knownProblems.title: A structure that generates in the world holds items that don't exist
knownProblems.explain: Chests and shelves in it will hold unknown items instead. The structure was made for another version of the game or expects another mod.

knownProblems.match: Unable to resolve block with code
knownProblems.title: World generation names a plant or block that doesn't exist
knownProblems.explain: That plant simply won't generate. A mod's world-generation file expects another mod, or an older version of one.

knownProblems.title: A cup is set to hold a bigger sip than it can
knownProblems.explain: The game corrects it by itself. Harmless.

knownProblems.title: A renamed block or item from an older version wasn't in this world
knownProblems.explain: After a game or mod update, old names are mapped to new ones. This one had nothing to map, which is normal for worlds that never had it.

knownProblems.match: Is a Code mod, but no ModSystems found
knownProblems.title: A mod with code has no code that starts
knownProblems.explain: The mod says it is a code mod, but the game found nothing in it to run on this side, so it does nothing here. On a server this is normal for a mod that only works in the player's game.
knownProblems.advice: If the mod should be doing something on this side, download it again or look for a version for this game.

knownProblems.match: files were found. These will be ignored
knownProblems.title: A mod carries code the game won't run
knownProblems.explain: Its modinfo.json says it is not a code mod, so the game ignores the code inside it. Whatever that code was for is missing.
knownProblems.advice: The mod's author has to set the type in modinfo.json to "code".

knownProblems.title: A creature threw an error while the server moved it
knownProblems.explain: The game skips that creature for the moment and carries on. If it repeats, that creature (or the mod it comes from) is broken: it may stand still, and the repeated error slows the server.
knownProblems.advice: The error right after it in the log names the code at fault. Removing the creature (or the mod) stops it.

knownProblems.title: A player's character threw an error while the server moved it
knownProblems.explain: Something the player wears, holds or is affected by fails every tick. The error right after it in the log names the code at fault.

knownProblems.match: There was an exception deleting the cached mod folder
knownProblems.title: An old unpacked copy of a mod couldn't be cleaned up
knownProblems.explain: The game unpacks mods into its Cache folder and clears old copies at start. Another program (an antivirus, a second copy of the game) held this one. It only wastes a little disk space.
